firstFive.what: A terminal-style control panel for stablecoins held across five chains, now on one screen: what is held and what it costs on the left, what governs it and what is waiting for a click on the right
firstFive.who: The owner of the funds, supervising what a connected AI agent is allowed to do with them
firstFive.action: Pick a timeframe or drag the chart; click APPROVE or REFUSE when the gate has a pending proposal

asked.requirement: One page, no routes, no navigation, no menus, no modals except the approval gate
asked.ref: single #page, zero nav elements, gate is an inline region not a modal

asked.requirement: All seven regions on screen together: status bar full width, then two columns, left is what is held and right is what governs it
asked.ref: status bar spans the page, then a two-column deck. Left: CHART (top left), COMPOSITION, COST. Right: APPROVAL GATE, POLICY, LOG. All seven visible at once at 1920x1200, 1512x982 and 1440x900

asked.requirement: The page never scrolls; a region that outgrows its box scrolls inside itself
asked.ref: measured at all three viewports: document.scrollHeight equals window.innerHeight, PAGE_SCROLL=no. Every .pbody is overflow:auto with min-height:0; comp and gate capped at 46vh, policy 26vh, cost 30vh; chart and log flex to fill. At 1440x900 the log scrolls internally while the page does not

asked.requirement: System monospace stack only, no webfont
asked.ref: style.css font-family ui-monospace stack, no @font-face, no font link

asked.requirement: Homebrew terminal palette, one hue by brightness/opacity
asked.ref: #0b0d0b ground, #33ff66 base with bright #8cffab and three opacity tiers; scrollbar thumbs use the existing --green-ghost

asked.requirement: Red in the chrome exclusively for pending, refusals, breached shares; the chart is the one exception
asked.ref: PENDING block + REFUSE button + approve_attempt_rejected log line are the only red chrome. The chart now draws red candles at #cc3a30, which is the declared exception and is darker and less saturated than the gate's #ff3b30. Weaker than the original rule: red is no longer unique to the gate, only the brightest red and the only bordered block

asked.requirement: No rounded corners, shadows, gradients, icons, illustration; box-drawing separation
asked.ref: frames still measured per column via layoutFrames reading parentElement.clientWidth, so both columns draw their own correct widths; slop-lint pass

asked.requirement: No animation except cursor blink and appending log lines
asked.ref: no transitions added; the only animation is still the status bar cursor

asked.requirement: Canvas candlesticks, green up and red down, tick-only axes, asset selectable, stale marker
asked.ref: measured on the live canvas at 1920x1200: 9032 green pixels and 6688 red at 1m, 5017/3354 at 1s, so both directions actually render. Bodies are solid in both directions now; the old up-solid/down-hollow convention is gone. Candle red is #cc3a30, darker than the gate's #ff3b30

asked.requirement: Charts come from Hyperliquid, timeframes down to 1s, chart sits top left with composition and cost under it
asked.ref: x-candle-source reads 'hyperliquid' at 1m and 'hyperliquid live trades' at 1s. Nine timeframes render (1s 5s 15s 1m 5m 15m 1h 4h 1d). Left column order measured as panel-chart -> panel-comp -> panel-cost, chart box at x=20 y=91 sized 949x528

asked.requirement: Chart handles like TradingView: plot drag pans, right axis drags price scale, bottom axis drags time scale, wheel zooms, double click resets
asked.ref: driven in a real browser at 1920x1200: plot drag right moved PAN_OFFSET 0->45; right-axis drag down moved PRICE_ZOOM 1->1.545; bottom-axis drag left moved VIEW_COUNT 120->245; cursors read grab / ns-resize / ew-resize over the three regions; double click reset zoom to 1 and pan to 0. A panned window is re-anchored on each push so a live chart does not slide out from under the drag, and pushes are suppressed entirely mid-drag

asked.requirement: Policy as plain sentences, never JSON
asked.ref: POLICY region renders $ prefixed sentences, unchanged
13px mono and 1.35 line height unchanged. The 104ch centred column is gone, replaced by two columns of about 115ch each on a 1920 screen: denser in aggregate, not airier

goal.outcome: The owner sees the whole machine at once, with no scrolling, and can judge what is there
goal.path: Open the page. Everything is already on screen. The one red block is the only thing asking for a decision
goal.why: The gate block sits at the top of the right column, the strongest position on the page after the status bar. The chart now owns the top left, which is where the eye lands first, and the gate holds the top right. The previous stacked layout buried the gate about 1200px down an 1838px page where it could only be reached by scrolling

notes.note: Below 1100px wide or 620px tall the layout falls back to the original single stacked column and the page scrolls again. One screen is not achievable on a phone at 13px, and shrinking the type to force it would break the terminal density requirement. Deliberate.
The log's 36ch hanging indent left messages one word wide under 760px. Pre-existing, not caused by this change, fixed in the same pass by dropping the indent at that width.

At 1440x900 the log's last visible line is cut mid-glyph by its own overflow container. Honest signal that the region scrolls, but a fade or a hard row cut would read cleaner. Left alone pending Karim's call.
